strings.funnel_detail_1: Collect academic, industry and news sources with original URLs and publication dates.
strings.funnel_detail_2: Screen for capacity, latency and throughput bottlenecks in LLMs and domain models. Title matches are candidates only.
strings.funnel_detail_3: Map objects, challenges and methods; retain promising adjacent techniques outside the compression map.
strings.funnel_detail_4: Verify mechanisms, models, hardware, datasets, baselines and results; distinguish author reports from local measurements.
strings.funnel_detail_5: Choose conditional validation, continued observation or no investment based on business value, migration cost and evidence.
strings.funnel_topics_detail: — accumulate principles, challenges, methods and limitations across years.
strings.funnel_month_detail: — include relevant publications or substantive revisions in the selected month, not merely newly collected or reviewed papers.
strings.funnel_decisions_detail: — retain evidence-backed, business-relevant techniques with executable validation paths; no paper quota.
strings.funnel_gate: Recommendation gate: identify the bottleneck, evidence conditions, Ascend adaptation and stop criteria. Below 1% quality loss is a business acceptance target requiring an agreed metric; reviewed does not mean qualified.

strings.funnel_background_badge: Background research · topic knowledge, not a new publication this month
